summary: Known issue for community.sops: Ansible documentation markup appears raw in ansible-doc text output on ansible-core older than 2.15; upgrade ansible-core or read the HTML docs.
questions: Why does ansible-doc show strange markup like I(...) or C(...) for community.sops modules?
How do I read community.sops docs cleanly on an old ansible-core?
Which ansible-core version renders collection doc markup properly?

answer_card.title: community.sops docs show raw markup in ansible-doc
answer_card.answer_md: On **ansible-core < 2.15**, `ansible-doc` prints community.sops documentation markup in raw form. Fix: upgrade to **ansible-core 2.15+**, or read the HTML docs at `https://docs.ansible.com/ansible/devel/collections/community/sops/`.
